name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted game library server with a built-in web client, in-browser emulation, metadata scraping and cloud saves, using an embedded PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: Retrom has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with RETROM_USERNAME and RETROM_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The desktop client cannot send these credentials, so use the web client.

The web client cannot upload games. Copy your platform and game folders into the retrom-library volume (mounted at /app/library), then run Library > Update Library. Metadata and artwork need IGDB API credentials set in the server configuration.
